newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares close up, VA Stahl at new high.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares close up, VA Stahl at new high.

text.p: Austrian shares closed slightly higher on Wednesday in thin trade and traders expected the market to remain stable ahead of Friday's expiry of February futures and options.
The Austrian Traded Index ended at 1,213.75 points, up 2.85 points. Among ATX stocks ten closed higher, nine were down and two remained unchanged.
"Most of the traders were rolling over their positions. Otherwise the volume in the cash market was very thin," a trader said.
ATX February futures closed at 1,214,10, up 3.0 points, on 3,161 contracts in the front month. Volume in March also topped 3,000 contracts.
"I see the ATX between 1,210 and 1,220 points for the next two days," a trader said.
Other market participants also saw the market within a narrow range.
"Sideways looks the most likely scenario," one said.
Top gainer in continuous trade was oil and chemical group OMV, up 1.86 percent at 1,400 ATS.
Steel maker VA Stahl continued its recent rally and gained eight schillings to close at a new high of 465.
Leading decliner was brewer BBAG, down 3.82 percent at 705.
